summary: Filix was a high-ranking female Nomai and a bridge officer on Escall's Vessel alongside Annona. She identified the Eye's signal as older than the universe, escaped via Escape Pod 1 to Brittle Hollow, taught Nomai children in the Hanging City, and co-built the Eye Signal Locator on the Attlerock with Cassava.

location: Filix served as a bridge officer on Escall's Vessel.
Filix landed on Brittle Hollow with Escape Pod 1.
lore: Filix identified the Vessel's incoming signal as older than the universe itself.
Filix protested Escall's order to warp immediately, wanting time to message other Nomai clans about the find.
Escall overruled Filix's protest out of fear the signal might disappear.
Filix and Annona verified the Vessel's warp core and navigation systems before warping; both functioned properly.
After the crash, Filix broadcast the Vessel's distress call before fleeing the bridge and boarding Escape Pod 1.
On Brittle Hollow, Filix's equipment could hear distress signals from Escape Pods 2 and 3 but she could not contact them.
Filix recorded everything she knew about the Eye's signal in the Brittle Hollow temporary settlement.
Filix noted the Eye's signal looked like an eye: round with a circle at the center like a pupil.
Filix proposed using gravity crystals to craft a stable path when the Nomai migrated to Brittle Hollow's northern glacier.
Filix participated in early discussions of Brittle Hollow's quantum phenomena, including the Quantum Moon.
Filix taught young Nomai in the Hanging City school about Nomai history and culture.
Filix told the children festivals happen every ten years.
Filix co-built the Eye Signal Locator on the Attlerock with Cassava after the Ember Twin and Brittle Hollow Nomai were reunited.
Filix and Privet calibrated the Attlerock locator correctly, but it still failed to detect the Eye.
Filix agreed with building a more sophisticated locator on Brittle Hollow's southern glacier.
Filix anticipated young Conoy would enjoy the new Southern Observatory locator immensely.
Filix was excited to see the new warp tower at White Hole Station, saying it had been a long time since she jumped through a black hole.
Filix does not appear to have been involved in the Ash Twin Project, suggesting she may have died beforehand.
